notes: This portable C++ TCK case uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It subscribes to standard HLAreportMOMexception and HLAreportServiceInvocation, attempts to enable Service Reporting with a well-formed HLAsetSwitches parameter, validates the standard precondition-failure report, then removes the conflicting subscription and verifies that enabling succeeds. It does not constrain synchronous exception type or text and uses no provider-specific names, headers, registries, or internal state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM lookup, subscription, interaction invocation, callback service, Service Reporting query, and lifecycle; FederateAmbassador.receiveInteraction report observation
